feature_owner.description: Primary agent that owns end-to-end feature delivery by planning, delegating specialist work, and validating completion.

implementer.description: Subagent for code implementation using the add-feature skill and existing project architecture.

tester.description: Subagent for adding tests, running focused test commands, and summarizing results using the add-test skill.

debugger.description: Subagent for diagnosing failures, forming hypotheses, and applying minimal root-cause fixes using the debug skill.

committer.description: Subagent for committing changes to git

feature.description: Plan and deliver a feature end-to-end using implementer, tester, and debugger.

test-fix.description: Investigate a failing test or command, patch the root cause, and hand back a re-test plan.

ship-feature.description: Run a final acceptance pass on an implemented feature and confirm whether it is ready to merge.

commit-feature.description: Commit changes for a feature to git
